description: This is a PHP source code file defining the EmployeeOnLeaveDao class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides data access methods for retrieving and counting employees on leave, including building database queries with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee leave information, facilitating queries related to employees on leave with filtering and pagination capabilities.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees on leave based on search filter parameters, utilizing a paginator for result management.

methods.name: getLeaveListPaginator
methods.description: Builds and configures a Doctrine QueryBuilder to generate a paginator for leave records, applying filters such as date, status, and employee access.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees currently on leave matching the search filters.
